# FG-GIT-0026

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`push-checks`](../../ops/runbooks/push-checks.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_history_import_that_cannot_be_recorded_is_fg_git_0026` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 履歴の取り込みは反映されましたが、その記録を保存できませんでした。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The history import was applied, but its record could not be saved. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Impor riwayat sudah diterapkan, tetapi catatannya tidak dapat disimpan. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

A push accepted under the one-time history import allowance (2026-11-12, ADR-0008 amendment "history import") was applied, but `forge serve` could not write its audit rows (`repository.history_imported` and one `repository.history_secret_imported` per finding only in history) nor mark the allowance used: the database failed or timed out (`cause_code`). The refs are updated; the allowance stays open until it expires, but it no longer applies because the repository is no longer empty.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

One alert log line with `error_code=FG-GIT-0026`, `request_id`, `repo_id`, `history_findings` and `cause_code`. Every history finding was logged before it with the same `request_id`: `forge.git.push_history_finding` (`rule`, `path`, `commit`, `blob`; never the value).

## 対処 (fix)

Fix the database cause (`cause_code`'s runbook). The findings are in the log lines of the request id: record them in the incident record and make sure the importer rotates every real secret among them. Runbook push-checks, "history import".
